title: Approval of a five (5)-year Contract with Smoke Guard California Inc.: Covering parts, services, and repairs for Smoke Guard screen systems in elevators at Los Angeles International Airport, for cost
text:
[CONSENT ITEMS FOR BOARD ACTION [Consent Items 1 - 18]]
RESOLUTION NO. - Adoption of the staff report; and Approval of a five (5)-year Contract with Smoke Guard California Inc.: Covering parts, services, and repairs for Smoke Guard screen systems in elevators at Los Angeles International Airport, for cost not to exceed $200,000 (Daniel Hughes)
summary: Approval of a five (5)-year Contract with Smoke Guard California Inc.: Covering parts, services.
